# Langbase

Langbase is a serverless AI developer platform that enables developers to build, collaborate, and deploy AI agents and applications with composable AI infrastructure.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/langbase/.

## Actions

- **Create a new pipe**: Create a new pipe.
- **Create Memory**: Create a new memory.
- **Create Thread**: Create a new conversation thread.
- **Delete Memory**: Delete a specific memory.
- **Get Thread Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific conversation thread.
- **List all pipes** (read-only): List all pipes.
- **List Documents in Memory** (read-only): List documents in a specific memory.
- **List Memories** (read-only): List all memory objects.
- **List Thread Messages** (read-only): List all messages in a conversation thread.
- **Split Content into Chunks** (read-only): Split content into smaller chunks.
